minka.label: Minka house
minka.desc: small traditional Japanese minka farmhouse with a thick thatched straw hipped roof, dark timber frame, cream plaster walls, paper shoji windows, a wooden veranda and stone foundation

crate.label: Wooden crate
crate.desc: small wooden produce crate with dark corner posts and cross bracing, a white daikon radish with green leaves peeking out of the top

pot.label: Clay pot
pot.desc: round terracotta clay storage pot (tsubo) with an indigo cloth band tied around its belly and a small wooden lid

toro.label: Stone lantern
toro.desc: Japanese stone garden lantern (toro): round base, pillar, square fire box with warm glowing paper windows, pyramidal stone roof and a jewel finial; mossy weathered grey stone

torii.label: Torii gate
torii.desc: vermilion lacquered Shinto torii gate with black lintel caps, black pillar bases and a small golden plaque in the centre

fence.label: Fence
fence.desc: short rustic wooden fence segment with two posts, two rails, green bamboo stakes behind and straw rope ties

trunk.label: Tree trunk
trunk.desc: gnarled tree trunk with three short branches (the leaves will be added separately), brown bark, a ring of moss at the base

well.label: Village well
well.desc: round stone village well with water inside, two dark wooden posts, a pulley beam, a rope with a small wooden bucket and a little grey tiled gable roof

stall.label: Merchant stall
stall.desc: small wooden Japanese market stall (yatai) with a dark grey tiled roof, indigo noren curtain strips with cream lettering-free patterns, red paper lanterns, and goods (fruit, a clay jar, a fish) on the counter

bridge.label: Arched bridge
bridge.desc: small arched wooden footbridge with light wood plank deck and vermilion lacquered railings with golden post caps

shrine_old.label: Quiet shrine
shrine_old.desc: small, long-forgotten Shinto shrine (hokora) on a stone platform: faded weathered dark wood, paint peeled off, roof tiles covered in thick green moss, ivy creeping up the posts, a sagging straw shimenawa rope, a tipped-over wooden offering box and a fallen brass bell in the grass; melancholic but cosy, waiting to be restored

shrine.label: Ebisu shrine
shrine.desc: small, freshly restored Shinto shrine (hokora) of Ebisu, god of fishermen and luck: stone platform, warm wooden hall with vermilion lacquered posts, paper lattice doors, grey tiled gable roof with golden crossed chigi and katsuogi on the ridge, a straw shimenawa rope with white paper shide zigzags, a golden bell with red rope, a golden fish plaque, a wooden offering box with gold trim and two red paper lanterns

pier.label: Fishing pier
pier.desc: long narrow wooden fishing pier: weathered light wood plank deck on dark wooden posts standing in the sea, a rope rail at the far end, a small paper lantern on a hook and a woven bait basket

stone.label: Sleeping stone
stone.desc: round mossy sacred boulder (iwakura) with a smaller stone on top, a thick straw shimenawa rope tied around its middle with two white paper shide zigzags, patches of moss

stairs.label: Stone stairs
stairs.desc: short flight of four grey granite steps with low stone side walls ending in round stone caps, a little moss in the joints

workbench.label: Workbench
workbench.desc: a sturdy Japanese carpenter’s workbench of pale cypress on dark trestle legs, a back rail with a wooden mallet, chisel and coiled rope, a pull-saw and wood shavings on top, planks on the lower shelf

noticeboard.label: Project board
noticeboard.desc: a small village notice board on two dark wooden posts with stone footings and a little tiled roof, cream paper notices pinned to it, one with a red seal

scaffold.label: Scaffolding
scaffold.desc: green bamboo scaffolding lashed with straw rope, pale wooden planks across it, a woven straw mat hung on the front and a little stack of timber and a stone at its foot

kakei.label: Bamboo water pipe
kakei.desc: a Japanese kakei: a length of green bamboo pipe resting on crossed dark sticks, a thin trickle of water falling into a round mossy stone basin

scarecrow.label: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: a friendly Japanese scarecrow (kakashi) on a wooden cross-pole, a wide straw hat, a cloth face, a patched indigo cotton coat with outstretched sleeves and a straw skirt

char_kenji.label: Kenji
char_kenji.desc: a cute chibi Japanese village carpenter, Kenji: a round friendly face with small dark eyes, black hair in a topknot under a white hachimaki headband, a short brown happi work coat with a dark sash, indigo trousers, straw sandals, a small wooden mallet in his right hand and a leather tool pouch at his hip

char_ume.label: Ume
char_ume.desc: a cute chibi elderly Japanese tea master, Ume: a kind round face with small dark eyes and rosy cheeks, silver-grey hair in a neat bun with a gold hairpin, a long sage-green kimono with wide sleeves, a red obi sash tied in a bow at the back, straw sandals

mill.label: Stone mill
mill.desc: a small Japanese stone hand mill: two round grey millstones with a wooden crank on a dark wooden stand, a spout with flour, cloth and straw sacks beside it, under a little four-post thatched roof

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.desc: a cosy Japanese outdoor kitchen: a reddish clay kamado stove with two black iron rice pots under pale wooden lids and glowing fire mouths, a wooden prep bench with a chopping board, a knife and a green vegetable, a shelf of white bowls on dark posts behind, under a small grey tiled roof
